mostWorthwhile.text: Making the filter and learning that clearer water can still contain harmful microbes was the most worthwhile passage.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling and then covering the water jar felt predictable, though it served the goal.

surprise.text: The new soap goal after plumbing the washstand expanded the task, and the ash-to-lye explanation clarified how soap could be made.

arbitrary.text: Burning charcoal to make ash was a plausible guess, but its connection to soap was not clear until the later lye explanation.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see another practical construction with explanations that connect the steps, though the predictable fittings were less engaging.
